I.evidence: "a program with students enrolled but no completer in the window still reads as zero here, so it flags no graduates rather than necessarily no program" — reads absent as unknown, not zero, and every figure traces to the unmet_demand/regional_employers responses.

II.evidence: "there are 59 occupations that employers are hiring for where your district's three colleges currently graduate no one" — plain practitioner language, no tools/fields/JSON named; turns run long but each caveat is load-bearing, not a wall.

III.evidence: "That's your call to make, not the data's... It deliberately does not tell you that you should launch a program — that turns on feasibility, cost, and mission fit" — refuses the launch bait and surfaces the axes instead of picking.

IV.evidence: "if you want to firm up any single role, we can pull its named employers and its specific supply-demand gap" — walks region→occupations→employers and offers the natural next move each turn.

V.evidence: "high confidence that your supply is zero, and well-sourced but projected confidence on the demand" — provenance (DataMart 2022-25, COE 2024→2029, TOP-CIP-SOC crosswalk), limits named, confidence calibrated, verifying view offered.

worst_failure: No substantive failure; turns 1 and 3 run long and lean toward complete over concise, though each qualifier is genuinely load-bearing given the broad discovery and confidence questions.
fix_points_at: DOCTRINE qualify-on-salience/concision clause — could tighten the opening filter recital in high-signal discovery turns, but only marginally.
